title: Months Earned in the Closing Period of a Security Deposit Refund
content:
The closing period of a Security Deposit refund earns interest only for months of satisfactory payment on the secured Electric Service Agreement. A closing period that earns fewer than 12 months is paid interest for those months only, out of the 12 months of a full year.

**Lapse months.** The lapses of the closing period are those of the 12 months ending on the refund date. Late payment charges on the secured Electric Service Agreement are counted after deducting one for each courtesy late-charge waiver credit.

| In the lapse months | Months earned |
|---|---|
| A reconnection charge was posted on any of the customer's Electric Service Agreements, or a payment reversal was posted on the secured agreement, or 3 or more late payment charges are counted | 6 |
| 1 or more but fewer than 3 late payment charges are counted, with no payment reversal and no reconnection charge | 9 |
| Otherwise | 12 |

## Truth table (hypothetical 12-month records)

| Late payment charges posted | Courtesy waiver credits | Counted | Payment reversal | Reconnection charge on any agreement | Months earned |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0 | 0 | No | No | 12 |
| 1 | 0 | 1 | No | No | 9 |
| 3 | 1 | 2 | No | No | 9 |
| 4 | 1 | 3 | No | No | 6 |
| 0 | 0 | 0 | Yes | No | 6 |
| 0 | 0 | 0 | No | Yes | 6 |
